representation_type.description: This field tells the type of the custom field.

id_prefix.description: This field is the unique custom ID string for the custom field.

items.description: *Conditional*. Only relevant for custom fields of type `reference`. This array of strings reflects the allowed types of objects that can be written to a `reference` custom field value.

is_formula_field.description: *Conditional*. This flag describes whether a custom field is a formula custom field.

is_value_read_only.description: *Conditional*. This flag describes whether a custom field is read only.

people_value.description: *Conditional*. Only relevant for custom fields of type `people`. This array of [compact user](/reference/users) objects reflects the values of a `people` custom field.

reference_value.description: *Conditional*. Only relevant for custom fields of type `reference`. This array of objects reflects the values of a `reference` custom field.

html_text_value.description: *Conditional*. Only relevant for custom fields of type `text`. This is the HTML representation of the text value of a custom field, corresponding to the `text_value` plain-text field.

privacy_setting.description: The privacy setting of the custom field. *Note: Administrators in your organization may restrict the values of `privacy_setting`.*

default_access_level.description: The default access level when inviting new members to the custom field. This isn't applied when the `privacy_setting` is `private`, or the user is a guest. For local fields in a project or portfolio, the user must additionally have permission to modify the container itself.

resource_subtype.description: The type of the custom field. Must be one of the given values.
